notes: Recognizing simple equivalent fractions in Stage 4 is essential before converting between fractions, decimals and percentages in Stage 5.
Mastering fraction equivalence in Stage 5 is required before multiplying pairs of proper fractions in Stage 6.
Understanding liquid evaporation at Stage 4 provides the mechanical basis for explaining water cycle precipitation at Stage 5.
Decoding unfamiliar words in context is a foundational skill before distinguishing implicit subtext in Stage 5 non-fiction.
Constructing sequential loop algorithms is a prerequisite before adding branch selection logic (if/else) at Stage 5.
Conditional logic in Stage 5 is needed before functional decomposition and modular sub-routines in Stage 6.
Percentage calculations in Mathematics reinforce calculated digital fields in Computing database design.
